endpoints.title: Bulk Delete Messages
endpoints.description:
Delete multiple messages you've sent or one you have permission to delete.

This will always require `ManageMessages` permission regardless of whether you own the message or not.

Messages must have been sent within the past 1 week.

parameters.name: X-Audit-Log-Reason
parameters.description: Reason for action which is stored in the audit log.

verification.test: messages: delete and bulk delete; MessageDelete event
